editorial.tldr: Three unrelated arXiv papers share only the phrase "empirical study" in their titles. They cover coding agents on clinical trial protocols (Oct 13), calibrated attack triage (Oct 21), and LLMs on knowledge-graph-to-text (Oct 22).
editorial.whats_new: A new arXiv paper benchmarks recent LLMs on knowledge-graph-to-text generation against fine-tuned encoder-decoder models on standard benchmarks (Oct 22).
editorial.why_it_matters: This is a keyword cluster, not one developing story: each paper is a separate, single-source preprint, so treat each result on its own terms.
editorial.take_for_builders: Do not treat these as one trend; read the clinical-protocol coding-agent paper if you build long-document extraction agents, and wait for replication before acting on any of the three.
